SELECT
  COALESCE(t.id, th2.id) AS theme_id,
  CASE WHEN NULLIF($2, '') IS NOT NULL THEN $2 ELSE NULL END AS slot_id,
  COALESCE(t.title, th2.title, s.theme) AS theme_title,
  COALESCE(t.motivation, '') AS motivation,
  COALESCE(t.rationale, s.goal, '') AS theme_rationale,
  COALESCE(t.client_id, s.client_id) AS client_id,
  c.name AS client_name,
  c.archetype,
  c.adversary,
  c.brand_goal,
  COALESCE(c.max_research_items_per_theme, 8) AS max_items,
  COALESCE(t.title, s.theme, s.search_terms) AS search_label
FROM clients c
LEFT JOIN themes t ON t.id = NULLIF($1, '') AND t.client_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN content_slots s ON s.id = NULLIF($2, '') AND s.client_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN themes th2 ON th2.id = s.theme_id
WHERE (NULLIF($1, '') IS NOT NULL AND t.id IS NOT NULL)
   OR (NULLIF($2, '') IS NOT NULL AND s.id IS NOT NULL)
LIMIT 1
DELETE FROM research_items WHERE ($1 != '' AND theme_id = $1) OR ($2 != '' AND slot_id = $2)

SELECT id, title, url, category, trello_board_id, max_units_per_run
FROM sources
WHERE client_id = $1 AND COALESCE(active, 1) = 1
  AND (
    (category = 'url_rss' AND url IS NOT NULL AND url != '')
    OR (category = 'trello' AND trello_board_id IS NOT NULL AND trello_board_id != '')
    OR (category IN ('scraper', 'linkedin') AND scraper_api_token_ref IS NOT NULL AND scraper_api_token_ref != '')
  )
ORDER BY category ASC, title ASC
LIMIT 12

SELECT ni.subject AS title, ni.body_text AS contentSnippet, ni.source_id, s.title AS source_title
FROM newsletter_items ni
INNER JOIN sources s ON s.id = ni.source_id AND s.category = 'mailbox'
WHERE s.client_id = $1
  AND COALESCE(s.active, 1) = 1
ORDER BY ni.received_at DESC
LIMIT 15

INSERT INTO research_items (id, theme_id, slot_id, source_id, source_type, title, snippet, url, item_rationale, feedback)
VALUES ($1, NULLIF($2, ''), NULLIF($3, ''), NULLIF($4, ''), $5, $6, $7, NULLIF($8, ''), $9, 'none')
